title: Palindrome Permutation
description: Check if a permutation of a string can form a palindrome by checking if at most one character appears an odd number of times.
pseudocode:
1. Initialize a set to track odd occurrences
2. For each character in string:
3. If char is in set, remove it
4. Else, add it to set
5. Return size of set <= 1
